title: Identification of aryl hydrocarbon receptor allosteric antagonists from clinically approved drugs.
authors: Mosa, Farag E S; Alqahtani, Mohammed A; El-Ghiaty, Mahmoud A; Dyck, Jason R B; Barakat, Khaled; El-Kadi, Ayman O S
one_liner_zh: 该文用计算建模和MD模拟筛选FDA药物靶向AhR转录因子的别构位点，研究药物对AhR-ARNT-DNA复合物形成的抑制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作相关但非直接TF-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移。
abstract: The human aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR), a ligand-dependent transcription factor, plays a pivotal role in a diverse array of pathways in biological and pathophysiological events. This position AhR as a promising target for both carcinogenesis and antitumor strategies. In this study we utilized computational modeling to screen and identify FDA-approved drugs binding to the allosteric site between alpha2 of bHLH and PAS-A domains of AhR, with the aim of inhibiting its canonical pathway activity. Our findings indicated that nilotinib effectively fits into the allosteric pocket and forms interactions with crucial residues F82, Y76, and Y137. Binding free energy value of nilotinib is the lowest among top hits and maintains stable within its pocket throughout entire (MD) simulations time. Nilotinib has also substantial interactions with F295 and Q383 when it binds to orthosteric site and activate AhR. Surprisingly, it does not influence AhR nuclear translocation in the presence of AhR agonists; instead, it hinders the formation of the functional AhR-ARNT-DNA heterodimer assembly, preventing the upregulation of regulated enzymes like CYP1A1. Importantly, nilotinib exhibits a dual impact on AhR, modulating AhR activity via the PAS-B domain and working as a noncompetitive allosteric antagonist capable of blocking the canonical AhR signaling pathway in the presence of potent AhR agonists. These findings open a new avenue for the repositioning of nilotinib beyond its current application in diverse diseases mediated via AhR.
abstract_zh: 人芳香烃受体（aryl hydrocarbon receptor, AhR）是一种配体依赖性转录因子，在多种生物学和病理生理学事件中发挥关键作用，这使其成为致癌和抗肿瘤策略中的有前景靶点。在本研究中，我们利用计算建模筛选并识别与AhR的bHLH alpha2和PAS-A结构域之间变构位点结合的FDA批准药物，旨在抑制其经典通路活性。我们的发现表明，尼洛替尼（nilotinib）有效适配于变构口袋，并与关键残基F82、Y76和Y137形成相互作用。尼洛替尼的结合自由能值在最优候选药物中最低，并在整个分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟时间内保持其口袋内的稳定性。当尼洛替尼结合正构位点并激活AhR时，它还与F295和Q383具有显著相互作用。令人惊讶的是，在存在AhR激动剂的情况下，它并不影响AhR核转位；相反，它阻碍功能性AhR-ARNT-DNA异二聚体组装的形成，从而阻止CYP1A1等调控酶的上调。重要的是，尼洛替尼对AhR表现出双重影响，通过PAS-B结构域调节AhR活性，并在强效AhR激动剂存在时作为非竞争性变构拮抗剂，能够阻断经典AhR信号通路。这些发现为尼洛替尼在AhR介导的多种疾病中超越其当前应用的重定位开辟了新途径。
